Name: Kindling
Notes: THE SIMPLEST ROW IN THE FILE, and the one to copy first. Two Fire players in the stack and every shot is worth 2 more until the cycle comes round

Name: Blaze
Notes: Replaces Kindling rather than adding to it - only the HIGHEST breakpoint you have reached in a trait is active. That is what makes 3/4 worth chasing

Name: Firestorm
Description: 3 damage to every enemy on the pitch
Notes: Lasts = once, so it happens the moment you reach it and does not happen again until the cycle resets. This is the pay-off row

Name: Undertow
Notes: A small patch-up the moment the second Water player passes

Name: The River Returns
Description: Brings one knocked-out player back with 3 stamina
Notes: Value = HOW MANY to bring back. Target = how much stamina each one gets up with. Leave Target blank to use adventure_revive_stamina from Tuning.csv

Name: Rootbound
Description: Every hit against you is 2 softer
Notes: Shield is taken off each incoming hit, and a hit can never be reduced below adventure_damage_minimum - so it slows them, it does not stop them

Name: The Grove Answers
Description: A Treant walks on to replace somebody who is out
Notes: Target names a row of AdventureSpawns.csv. The Treant takes the tier of whoever it is replacing, and its power is clamped into that tier's rungs - the tier ladder is never broken, not even by a spawn

Name: All Smoke
Notes: A whole side of one class fills this by itself, so keep it modest - it is a perk, not a plan

Name: Same Song
Description: 2 stamina to whoever is worst off
Notes: Target = lowest / all / last. `last` is whoever took the shot

Name: Star Turn
Notes: A single Star in the stack is already worth something

Name: Both Stars
Description: 5 damage straight into the enemy you are focusing
Notes: Two Stars in one cycle means the cycle came round, which is why this is the biggest single hit in the table

Name: Honest Graft
Notes: The starter team gets the plain version of everybody else's perk. It is meant to be the boring one

Name: Journeymen
Notes: The Rivals had an icon and nothing that fired it - the bar filled up and it never did anything. The workbench found that; this is the fix

Name: Old Pros
Description: Every hit against you is 1 softer
